chunks: And it was narrated in another hadith:
If he has seen wetness and had not urinated, then let him perform wudu (ablution) and not ghusl, for that is only from the residual moisture.

key_terms.الْحَبَائِلِ: residual internal moisture or remaining discharge
key_terms.بَلَلًا: wetness or moisture seen by a person

ai.seo_question: If someone sees wetness after janabah but has not urinated, does he need ghusl or only wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity after seeing wetness. It states that if a person sees moisture without having urinated, he should perform wudu (ablution) rather than ghusl, because the moisture is treated as residual discharge.
